Prototype 1 encodes REM (89% pure) primarily through EEG (61%), with EOG (38%) and EMG (1%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows suppressed δ (-2.2 dB, sensitivity=16.1) and elevated γ (+1.2 dB, sensitivity=6.3).
The δ activity is present in 3% of each epoch (transient), with quiescent eye movements (REM 3% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with REM physiology: confirmed: EOG dominant, θ elevated; missing: EMG atonic. Note: model primarily uses δ, atypical for REM.
